about.description: Turquoise Place is a beachfront condo resort in Orange Beach, Alabama, managed by Brett/Robinson Vacation Rentals, a family-owned company with over 40 years of experience. The property offers beachfront condos with modern amenities, resort-style pools, and direct Gulf access.
about.elevator_pitch: Beachfront luxury condo resort in Orange Beach with premier amenities and family-friendly accommodations on the Gulf of Mexico.
about.age_restriction: Must be 25 years of age to book
